content.Clinical Guideline Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

3.2.4. Periodic Imaging After Valve Inte: Emphasizes the importance of routine imaging to assess heart valve function after replacement.
Discusses the effect of hemodynamic deterioration in surgically implanted bioprosthetic aortic valves.

3.2.1. Diagnosis and Follow-Up: Recommendations for echocardiographic assessment are provided.
Emphasizes the importance of identifying systemic hypertension in the context of aortic stenosis.
